title: Symmetry of the neighbor sum
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D$, and let $g$ be a rational-valued function of two vertices. Summing $g(u,v)$ over every vertex $u$ and every indexed neighbor $v$ of $u$ gives the same result as summing $g(v,u)$ over those same ordered pairs.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
$g$ is a rational-valued function of two vertices
